description: SAFE Conversion & Cap Table Calculator — Converts YC-style SAFEs in a priced round, offline. Required: safes= entries amount:cap:discount separated by ; (0 = no cap or no discount), pre_money= (round pre-money valuation), investment= (new money). Optional: shares= fully diluted shares before the round excluding safes (default 10000000), pool= option-pool top-up as % of post-round fully diluted, type=post (post-money safe, default) or pre. Solves the pre-money circularity (safes + pool inside pre-money). Returns round price per share, post-money valuation, per-safe cap/discount/conversion price and basis (CAP/DISCOUNT/ROUND_PRICE), shares, ownership and multiple, pro-forma cap table and founder dilution. Price: $0.003 USDC (Base, via x402).
name: finance_safe_conversion
